Personality: Alary, son of King Derthert of Vlandia, exhibits a personality marked by distinct pragmatism and shrewd calculation. Neither naturally merciful nor open-handed, he prefers to weigh pros and cons and pursue practical results when making decisions rather than let emotion guide him. Though he may appear stern toward subordinates and commoners alike and rarely bestows favors lightly, his deliberate nature enables him to read situations clearly and devise effective strategies. While neutral in matters of honor and raw valor, he is a highly skilled warrior who excels with polearms and two-handed weapons, making him a formidable presence on the battlefield. Combining intellect with martial force, he dedicates himself to defending Vlandia's interests and striving for his family's glory, even when doing so requires measures that are less than merciful.
Background: Alary is the son of King Derthert and Queen Philenora of Vlandia, raised from birth within one of the mightiest kingdoms on the continent of Calradia. As a scion of Clan dey Meroc, he underwent rigorous knightly training and military education from boyhood, with Vlandian traditions and martial spirit etched deep into his bones. At just twenty-six years old, he has already demonstrated exceptional military talent, mastering polearms, two-handed weapons, and one-handed blades as a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. As a lord of Vlandia, he stands unswervingly loyal to his father King Derthert, bearing the heavy responsibility of his clan's honor and the kingdom's future. His upbringing has shaped a shrewd, pragmatic temperament that makes him an influential if controversial figure on both the political and military stages.
